name: outage-lease-expires
about: A run's host goes away mid-build (#592: the dev box crashed): the lease stops heartbeating a minute in, and loopd next sweeps hours later (the next runner's poll), well past the 45-minute cap. The lease expired before the cap, so the item goes back to the build queue (lease_expired), not to the user as overtime.

messages.text: ^Lease expired; back in the build queue\.$
